name: Denmark
title: BENEFITS provider tool: Denmark
wave_label: No microsimulation for this country: extra income estimated from national minimum-income outlays (EUROMOD external statistics and named national sources) and Eurostat income deciles

wellby_spine.label: DKK 164,749 (HM Treasury's GBP 13,000 per WELLBY at 2019 prices, applied as GBP 16,300 at 2024 prices, converted at household-consumption PPP)
wellby_spine.provenance_note: HM Treasury (2021) Wellbeing Guidance for Appraisal, GBP 13,000 per WELLBY at 2019 prices (low 10,000, high 16,000), applied as GBP 16,300 (12,540 / 20,064) at 2024 prices by HM Treasury's own uprating method, converted at DKK 10.1073 per GBP (Eurostat prc_ppp_ind, E011 household final consumption, 2024). A transfer, flagged as such.

capacity_caveat: The capacity and shock model is INDICATIVE: demand elasticities and staff ratios are mostly UK register values, and the share of households losing an earner is the UK model's own share applied to Denmark's working-age households. It is not calibrated to Denmark.
provenance: No microsimulation for Denmark: the income effect is estimated from the national minimum-income outlay and Eurostat income deciles, and household counts, price levels and labour costs are Eurostat database tables (nama_10_gdp, prc_ppp_ind, lc_lci_lev, lfst_hhnhtych, demo_pjan, ilc_di01, ilc_lvps02), retrieved September 2026. Provider values are per person served, in DKK at 2024 prices. Every value carries its source and a grade in its own note; a value borrowed from another country is marked.

services.name: Employment support

provenance_note.elastLow: UK register value for Jobcentre Plus work coaches (demand moves one-for-one with unemployment, range 0.8 to 1.2), transferred unadjusted
provenance_note.elastCentral: UK register value for Jobcentre Plus work coaches (demand moves one-for-one with unemployment, range 0.8 to 1.2), transferred unadjusted
provenance_note.elastHigh: UK register value for Jobcentre Plus work coaches (demand moves one-for-one with unemployment, range 0.8 to 1.2), transferred unadjusted
provenance_note.staffRatio: UK register benchmark, shown for reference only: no formula in the tool reads it; the extra-caseworker figure uses the provider's own cases per caseworker.
provenance_note.unitCost: DKK 12,560, converted from the UK tool's unit cost for Jobcentre Plus work coaching, GBP 1,200 per participant, itself an assumption declared at the 2024 base. Converted on average hourly labour cost in health and social work (Eurostat lc_lci_lev, NACE Q, 2023: Denmark EUR 42.40 an hour; UK GBP 30.2165), ratio 10.466380. No verified Denmark figure for this unit was found. CONVERSION: GBP 1200 x 10.46637963. PRICE BASE: 2024-equivalent. Unit: one participant in an employment-support episode.

services.flag: Unit: one participant in an employment-support episode. Outcome value: borrowed from another country without adjustment. +0.46 WELLBY for a move from unemployment into work (Clark et al. 2018, the Britain fixed-effects coefficient HM Treasury's guidance uses), valued at the WELLBY value for Denmark, then staged as in the UK tool: effect 0.11 / 0.30 / 0.46 x attribution 0.20 / 0.22 / 0.27. European trial evidence (Card, Kluve and Weber 2018) puts job-search assistance impacts at 1 to 2 percentage points, which suggests the staged central may be high. ORIGIN 16300 FACTOR 4.6493607107; BAND ORIGIN 12540 AND 20064; BAND FACTOR 4.6493607107 AND 4.6493607107; STAGE EFFECT 0.11 0.3 0.46 ATTRIBUTION 0.2 0.22 0.27; PRICE BASE: 2024-equivalent.

services.flag: Unit: one claim supported. Outcome value: borrowed from another country with a stated adjustment. Income effect: the extra-income figure. Health-service use avoided: Liverpool Citizens Advice on Prescription (SSM Population Health 2025), an instrumental-variable study on linked NHS records: GBP 91 per person a year (95% CI 44 to 107) at 2023 prices, an impact, so attribution 1.0. The saving is per household member; the central counts the client only, the high counts every member (20,773 members of 8,205 client households). Uprated to 2024-25 on ONS L8GG and converted at household-consumption PPP (Eurostat, 2024). The advice covered benefits, debt and housing together. ORIGIN 91 FACTOR 10.5040391388; BAND ORIGIN 44 AND 230.3891529555; BAND FACTOR 10.5040391388 AND 10.5040391388; STAGE EFFECT 1 1 1 ATTRIBUTION 1 1 1; PRICE BASE: 2024-equivalent.

provenance_note.elastCentral: Sosenko et al. (2022), 325 English local authorities: one point of unemployment adds about 2% to food-parcel use; Loopstra et al. (2016), 21 EU countries: one point adds 0.29 points to food insecurity (svc_income-150, -139). Crises cause separate surges of 30 to 100%
provenance_note.elastHigh: Sosenko et al. (2022), 325 English local authorities: one point of unemployment adds about 2% to food-parcel use; Loopstra et al. (2016), 21 EU countries: one point adds 0.29 points to food insecurity (svc_income-150, -139). Crises cause separate surges of 30 to 100%

services.flag: Unit: one recipient for a year. Outcome value: an assumption. Excluded for every country: no robust per-person effect exists. Randomised evidence shows small effects on food insecurity (for example Briefel et al., -2.8 points) and none on wellbeing; the Greek DIATROFI school-meal trial is a different service. The tool shows the income effect only, as a floor.

services.flag: Unit: one advice case. Outcome value: borrowed from another country without adjustment. Being in arrears lowers life satisfaction by 0.355 points (FCA / Simetrica-Jacobs 2020, individual fixed effects). Low: zero, because the only randomised trial (Pleasence and Balmer 2007) cannot rule it out. High: the UK tool's high. ORIGIN 16300 FACTOR 3.588093592; BAND ORIGIN 12540 AND 20064; BAND FACTOR 0 AND 5.0536529464; STAGE EFFECT 0 0.1 0.63 ATTRIBUTION 1 1 0.5; PRICE BASE: 2024-equivalent.

A year of homelessness costs the public DKK 398,741 per person (the UK tool's GBP 26,988 (Crisis 2015, uprated) scaled by the cost of the same year of homelessness in Denmark relative to the UK, 1.677, from Pleace et al. provenance_note.elastCentral: UK register value, transferred unadjusted; a systematic review (Hiilamo et al. 2021) found no European population-level recession effect

provenance_note.unitCost: DKK 114,764, converted from Home Office (2021) GBP 8,640 per child in need per year at 2018/19 prices, uprated to GBP 10,965 (the UK tool's figure). Converted on average hourly labour cost in health and social work (Eurostat lc_lci_lev, NACE Q, 2023: Denmark EUR 42.40 an hour; UK GBP 30.2165), ratio 10.466380. No verified Denmark figure for this unit was found. CONVERSION: GBP 10965 x 10.46637963. PRICE BASE: 2024-equivalent. Unit: one child supported at home for a year.

services.flag: Unit: one child supported at home for a year. Outcome value: a national source. A year of out-of-home care costs DKK 523,484 per child (Danmarks Statistik (2025), StatBank REGK31 (Municipal accounts by functions) and ANB10 (Children and young persons placed outside of own home per 31st December, by place of accommodation), DKK 523,484 at 2024 prices, uprated on the GDP deflator.). Reduction in the chance of a residential placement: central 0.056 (Italy, P.I.P.P.I. against a comparison group, residential placements only: 6.4% against 0.8%), high 0.119 (the same, counting day foster care too), low zero (Al et al. 2012 meta-analysis: intensive family preservation generally does not prevent placement). One year of placement avoided is counted, which is conservative. The sensitivity row is the UK tool's route: the lifetime cost of a maltreatment case (Bocconi 2013, Italy) x 0.086. ORIGIN 523484 FACTOR 1; BAND ORIGIN 523484 AND 523484; BAND FACTOR 1 AND 1; STAGE EFFECT 0 0.056 0.119 ATTRIBUTION 1 1 1; PRICE BASE: 2024-equivalent.

services.flag: Unit: one client for a treatment year. Outcome value: borrowed from another country without adjustment. Value of a statistical life for Denmark: DKK 70,316,787 (OECD 2025 base VSL for the EU, USD 8.4m at 2022 PPP, transferred by GDP per head in PPS with income elasticity 1.0, as the OECD recommends). Deaths averted per 1,000 opioid-client-years: central 21.45 (France, 175,000 patients, 2026), low 6.5 (Czechia), high 24.8 (Sordo et al. 2017, methadone). Non-opioid clients carry no averted-death value in these figures.
